levels.title: Filter with BETWEEN for Dates
levels.task: The planning team wants to study music trends in 2023. Show all columns for every song released between January 1, 2023 and December 31, 2023.
levels.solution: SELECT * FROM top_songs WHERE release_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31';
levels.successMessage: Good work! You listed only the 2023 songs.

levels.title: Using LIKE with Wildcards
levels.task: The marketing team is making a pink-themed playlist poster. Find song titles that contain the word 'pink'.
levels.solution: SELECT track_name FROM top_songs WHERE track_name LIKE '%pink%';
levels.successMessage: Nice! The pink playlist titles are ready.

levels.title: Albums Starting with f
levels.task: For a February magazine spread, the design team needs every song where the album name starts with the letter F, show all columns for each song.
levels.solution: SELECT * FROM top_songs WHERE album_name LIKE 'F%';
levels.successMessage: Done! You’ve filtered the songs for the design feature.

levels.title: Songs Released in May 2024
levels.task: To celebrate the start of spring, the marketing team needs every song released in May 2024. Show all columns for each song released in May 2024.
levels.solution: SELECT * FROM top_songs WHERE release_date LIKE '2024-05-%';
levels.hintMessage: Use LIKE with a date pattern like '2024-05-%'.
levels.successMessage: Perfect! The May playlist is ready to go.

levels.title: Select with IN
levels.task: You’re building a comparison between Taylor Swift, Kendrick Lamar, and Morgan Wallen. Show all columns for all songs by these artists.
levels.solution: SELECT * FROM top_songs WHERE artist IN ('Taylor Swift', 'Kendrick Lamar', 'Morgan Wallen');
levels.hintMessage: Use artist IN ('Taylor Swift', 'Kendrick Lamar', 'Morgan Wallen').
levels.successMessage: Great! All three artists are in one result table.
